findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "overhead_conductor" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "read_tender" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "design_presets" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List what the cable designer builds, before calling design_cable: presets[] (power, MV, HV, North American, building wire, cords, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre),…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
